sections.name: Verse 1
lines: [C]Together [F]let us sweetly [C]live,
[C7]I am [F]bound for the land of Canaan.
[F]Together love to Jesus [Bb]give;
[C7]I am bound [F]for the land of Canaan.

sections.name: Refrain
lines: [C]O Canaan, [F]bright Canaan,
[C7]I am [F]bound for the land of Canaan.
[F]O Canaan, [Am]it [Dm]is my happy [Bb]home,
[C7]I am bound [F]for the land of Canaan.

sections.name: Verse 2
lines: [C]Together [F]let us watch [C]and pray;
[C7]I am [F]bound for the land of Canaan.
[F]And wait redemption's [Bb]joyous day;
[C7]I am bound [F]for the land of Canaan.

sections.name: Verse 3
lines: [C]Our songs [F]of praise shall fill [C]the skies;
[C7]I am [F]bound for the land of Canaan.
[F]While higher still our joys [Bb]shall rise;
[C7]I am bound [F]for the land of Canaan.

sections.name: Verse 4
lines: [C]Then come [F]with me, beloved [C]friend;
[C7]I am [F]bound for the land of Canaan.
[F]The joys to come shall never [Bb]end;
[C7]I am bound [F]for the land of Canaan.
